title: run installed-system local release channel consumer smoke

criteria: Consumer smoke follows local release channel metadata and reports installed-system install/update/rollback readiness from RC18 image evidence.
Consumer smoke is audited and does not execute new install, update, rollback, support upload, recovery, remote dispatch, host, or production effects.
No mirror/frontend, signer, object storage, private material, shell, TUI, model, or endpoint reachability authority is granted.
